reason: I'd take the free 15-company list, sure, but EUR 350 a meeting up to EUR 3,500 looks like what I'd pay for Apollo and a junior SDR for two months, and the SDR stays after. My partner will ask why we're renting someone else's pipeline instead of building our own, and this month I don't have a good answer.
objection: A junior SDR plus Apollo costs about the same and we keep the person and the know-how afterwards. Also the 45-meetings proof is a logistics client, not a distributor like us, so I can't show my partner it works in our niche.
would_change_my_mind: If the free list of 15 companies turned out to include buyers I really couldn't reach myself, and a reference distributor in our segment told me the meetings turned into quote requests, I'd take it to my partner for the pilot.
